workItem: Free/open crypto evidence provider delivery, Binance/Kraken primary sourcing and bounded Dune entitlement

providerDecisions.binance-public: co-primary keyless crypto spot/futures market and derivatives evidence supplier; no private/order authority
providerDecisions.kraken-futures-public: co-primary keyless independent crypto derivatives/liquidity/slippage evidence supplier; no private/order authority
providerDecisions.defillama: existing canonical DeFi TVL/fees/revenue evidence provider; retain ADR-0100 free evidence-only authority
providerDecisions.goplus: free/keyless EVM and Solana token-security evidence baseline; no x402/paid default
providerDecisions.dexscreener: keyless DEX pool/liquidity/activity specialist evidence for governed token identities
providerDecisions.sourcify: keyless EVM source/bytecode verification specialist evidence; not audit/formal-verification PASS
providerDecisions.gdelt: keyless news metadata/provenance source; no article-body republication or score authority
providerDecisions.dune: read-only Owner-keyed saved-query evidence with FREE_TIER or timestamp-bounded TRIAL_14D entitlement modes and mandatory allowlist/schema/row gates
providerDecisions.gemini: reuse existing ADR-0090 Free-Tier Research Shadow; no second same-project key for quota because Gemini limits are project-scoped

protectedExistingAuthorities: CryptoEvidenceIdentityRegistry for high-impact external provider identities
MarketDataGateway for canonical quote/snapshot routing only
ADR-0090 Gemini Free-Tier Research Shadow authority
correlationRules: Binance and Kraken are co-primary but remain independently attributable; similar observations are not automatic double confirmation.
Binance currently owns the generic derivatives raw-feature projection; Kraken remains an independent provider observation set until a separately versioned consensus/correlation transform exists.
DeFiLlama remains authoritative for existing free TVL/fees/revenue fields.
GoPlus/Sourcify security observations are raw evidence, not automatic security/audit/formal-verification PASS.
Dune query IDs/output schemas are governed and entitlement width never expands runtime query authority.
GDELT news metadata and deterministic headline heuristics have no direct scoring authority.
Missing/stale/unknown provider fields remain NOT_AVAILABLE/STALE/INVALID and never become 0 or PASS.
